name: path-jail
description: Allows writes only inside the project root, resolving symlinks and .. tricks.

allowedRoots.title: Extra allowed folders
allowedRoots.description: Comma-separated folders writes are also allowed in, besides the project root (~ expands to your home).

blockUncheckable.title: Block uncheckable shell writes
blockUncheckable.description: Deny Bash writes whose target uses $VARIABLES, command substitution or a cd the jail cannot follow. Turn off to let those through.
